constraints: The parameter object's .host property is mandatory; all other properties are optional and default as documented (e.g. .port defaults to 995, .connectionTimeOut to 30s, .acceptUnsecureConnection to False).

If .accessTokenOAuth2 is passed but .authenticationMode is omitted, the OAuth2 protocol is used (if allowed by the server); .authenticationMode otherwise defaults to the most secure mode supported by the server.
.accessTokenOAuth2 and .password are consumed for authentication but are not echoed back on the returned POP3Transporter object.
